column1: # p250 — `ACTION XJ` DISCHARGED. The sweep p249 was asked for, over the WHOLE carried
# METHOD. The old harvester and the fixed harvester were both run over all 8 shelves and
# their distinct-slug sets differenced. That is why this is a SWEEP and not another hand
# repair: nothing was guessed from a name, the two instruments were made to disagree and
# every disagreement was then read over the network.
#   new: same, with SLUG_RE made greedy                                       -> 1862 slugs
#   GAINED 30 (real names the base was truncating) / LOST 26 (the stumps it carried instead)
# grant     = raw.githubusercontent.com/<slug>/HEAD/<path>, Tier A, 16 root licence names
# RECOVERED 30: 29 EXIST, 1 ABSENT (UOC/java-lti-1.3-provider — its -provider-example does exist)
#   grants: 17 MIT · 1 Apache-2.0 · 3 AGPL-3.0 · 3 LGPL · 1 EPL-2.0+EDL-1.0 pointer file
# 🔴 THE ONE THAT EXISTS IS THE WHOLE FINDING. `TouchRefletz/maia.edu` truncated to
#    `TouchRefletz/maia`, and `TouchRefletz/maia` IS A REAL REPOSITORY — a different one:
#    Both answer 200 on existence. Both return a grant at Tier A. Both are AGPL-3.0. Both
#    are 34 523 B. Both hash to 8486a10c4393cee1. So EVERY check this base owns — existence,
#    grant reach, family, byte count AND the pinned sha — AGREES on the wrong repository.
#    The other 25 truncations fail loudly. This one cannot be caught downstream at all.
# 🔵 AND IT BOUNDS `ACTION WX` (p243: "same pinned grant sha => one row until proven
#    otherwise"). That rule is sound ONLY for families whose canonical text embeds a
#    copyright holder. Short MIT payloads (1 054–1 113 B) discriminate: dmitry-viskov/pylti1.3
#    and ucfopen/pylti1.3 share 5aef77eb4471effc BECAUSE ucfopen ships upstream's holder
#    line verbatim ("Copyright (c) 2019 Dmitry Viskov", read first-hand both sides). Stock
#    texts do NOT: AGPL-3.0 at 34 523 B carries no holder, so it collides across unrelated
#    repositories. A sha collision is evidence of one row ONLY in the holder-embedding tier.
# 🟢 FOUR recoveries are the SAME repository under two spellings, which is `ACTION UH`'s
#    class arriving through the dot: theopenem/OneRoster.NET + theopenem/oneroster.net +
#    -flask-example both 1672e02f459e4293. Case folding is DOWNSTREAM of the harvester
#    (see p250-component-map) — the harvester preserves case and always did.
